_metadata.description: Erasmus University Rotterdam Library database access list
_metadata.source: Compiled from libguides.eur.nl, eur.nl/library, EDSC news, manual verification, and a 2026-06 WRDS schema-access probe (has_schema_privilege over the WRDS Postgres gateway; 523 of 1283 libraries accessible)
_metadata.maintainer: Update manually when database access changes. Check eur.nl/en/library/research-support/edsc/edsc-news for updates. WRDS-delivered items can be re-verified with scripts/wrds_inventory.R.

databases.name: WRDS (Wharton Research Data Services)
databases.notes: Primary platform for many financial databases. Requires EUR account registration. EUR has SELECT access to ~523 WRDS libraries (verified 2026-06).

databases.name: Audit Analytics
databases.notes: Auditor, audit-fee, restatement, internal-control, and going-concern data. Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schemas: audit, audit_audit_comp, audit_acct_os). Audit Analytics Europe also available (schema: audit_europe).

databases.name: S&P Capital IQ
databases.notes: S&P Capital IQ via WRDS. Verified accessible 2026-06. Modules: company financials (ciq), earnings-call transcripts (ciq_transcripts), credit ratings (ciq_ratings), capital structure (ciq_capstrct), key developments, and people intelligence (ciq_pplintel).

databases.name: FactSet (via WRDS)
databases.notes: FactSet data modules accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schemas: factset, revere, factsamp_revere) - e.g. Revere business relationships / supply chain and ownership. NOTE: the standalone FactSet workstation/terminal is NOT subscribed at EUR; only the WRDS-delivered FactSet data is available.

databases.name: Preqin (via WRDS)
databases.notes: Private capital / PE-VC fund and deal data. Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schema: preqin). NOTE: the standalone Preqin subscription was discontinued (2025); use the WRDS-delivered Preqin instead.

databases.name: Circana (IRI) Retail Scanner
databases.notes: Retail point-of-sale / scanner data (formerly IRI, now Circana). Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schemas: iri, iri_all). This is the EUR alternative to NielsenIQ scanner data, which is NOT available.

databases.name: LPC DealScan
databases.notes: Syndicated and bank loan deal data. Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schemas: dealscan, tr_dealscan).

databases.name: FINRA TRACE
databases.notes: Corporate bond transaction (trade-level) data. Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schemas: trace, trace_enhanced). Pair with Mergent FISD for bond characteristics.

databases.name: RepRisk (ESG)
databases.notes: ESG risk-incident data. Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schema: reprisk). Other ESG sources on WRDS at EUR: S&P Trucost (environmental), MSCI ESG samples, LSEG/Refinitiv ESG (tresg).

databases.name: Federal Judicial Center (FJC)
databases.notes: US federal court case (litigation) data - the Integrated Database (IDB). Publicly available from fjc.gov; also mirrored on WRDS (schemas: fjc, fjc_litigation).

databases.name: Compustat Global
databases.notes: International company fundamentals. Access via WRDS.

databases.name: Compustat North America
databases.notes: US/Canada company fundamentals, annual reports, credit ratings, index constituents.

databases.name: CRSP (Center for Research in Security Prices)
databases.notes: US stock prices, returns, and indices.

databases.name: CRSP Treasury
databases.notes: US Treasury bond data.

databases.name: I/B/E/S (Institutional Brokers' Estimate System)
databases.notes: Analyst earnings forecasts and recommendations.

databases.name: ExecuComp
databases.notes: Executive compensation data for S&P 1500 firms (schemas: comp_execucomp, execcomp).

databases.name: BoardEx
databases.notes: Board of directors, executive profiles, and network connections. Regional coverage at EUR: NA, UK, EUR, ROW (schemas: boardex_na, boardex_uk, boardex_eur, boardex_row).

databases.name: ISS (Institutional Shareholder Services)
databases.notes: Corporate governance, director data, voting analytics, and ISS Incentive Lab (incl. Europe). Schemas: iss, risk_governance, risk_directors, iss_incentive_lab(_europe), iss_va_shareholder.

databases.name: OptionMetrics
databases.notes: Options prices, implied volatility, Greeks (US and Europe; schemas: optionm, optionmsamp_us, optionmsamp_europe).

databases.name: Mergent FISD
databases.notes: Fixed Income Securities Database - corporate bond characteristics.

databases.name: Thomson Reuters Ownership
databases.notes: Institutional holdings (13F filings).

databases.name: People Intelligence
databases.notes: Executive and board member information.

databases.name: S&P Transcripts
databases.notes: Earnings call transcripts (the S&P Capital IQ transcripts; schema: ciq_transcripts). License active until August 2026.

databases.name: PitchBook
databases.notes: Private market data (startups, PE, VC). Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schema: pitchbk). Earlier records listed access expiring Nov 2025, but it is still live as of the 2026-06 probe - re-confirm before long-term reliance.

databases.name: Revelio Labs
databases.notes: Labor market and workforce analytics. Verified accessible via WRDS 2026-06 (schemas: revelio, revelio_individual, revelio_workforce_dynamics, revelio_job_postings).

databases.name: RavenPack
databases.notes: News sentiment and analytics. A WRDS trial is currently accessible (schema: ravenpack_trial) as of 2026-06; the full subscription was previously discontinued (2025). Treat as trial - confirm before relying on it.

databases.name: LSEG Workspace (formerly Eikon/Datastream)
databases.notes: Room Y1-7 (Polak Building) - 10 terminals, no reservation. Also available via virtual machines. 2-hour daily limit. Worldscope/Datastream content is also reachable via WRDS (schemas: trws, tr_ds).

databases.name: SDC Platinum
databases.notes: M&A, IPOs, joint ventures, alliances. Access via LSEG Workspace; sample/linking tables also on WRDS (tr_sdc_samples).

databases.name: Orbis (Bureau van Dijk)
databases.notes: Global company information, financials, ownership structures. Also reachable via WRDS (schemas: bvd, bvd_orbis_trial, bvd_amadeus).

databases.name: Morningstar Direct
databases.notes: Mutual funds, ETFs, open-end and closed-end funds. Booking required for VM access.

databases.name: Bloomberg Terminal
databases.notes: Bloomberg license cancelled April 2024 due to budget cuts. Use LSEG Workspace as alternative.

databases.name: EBSCO Business Source Complete
databases.notes: Business journals, articles, and ebooks.

databases.name: JSTOR
databases.notes: Academic journals archive.

databases.name: Web of Science
databases.notes: Citation database and journal rankings.

databases.name: Scopus
databases.notes: Abstract and citation database.

databases.name: ProQuest
databases.notes: Dissertations, theses, newspapers, and journals.

databases.name: Statista
databases.notes: Statistics and market data across industries.

databases.name: OECD iLibrary
databases.notes: OECD publications, statistics, and datasets.

databases.name: Eurostat
databases.notes: European Union statistics. Publicly available.

databases.name: World Bank Open Data
databases.notes: Development indicators. Publicly available.

databases.name: IMF Data
databases.notes: International financial statistics. Publicly available.

databases.name: CBS StatLine
databases.notes: Netherlands official statistics. Publicly available.

databases.name: SEC EDGAR
databases.notes: US company filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements). Publicly available. WRDS also mirrors filings text (schemas: wrdssec, wrdssec_insiders).

databases.name: SSRN
databases.notes: Working papers and preprints. Publicly available.

databases.name: Eventus (via WRDS)
databases.notes: Event study software using CRSP data. WRDS also offers built-in event-study tools (schemas: wrdsapps_evtstudy_us, wrdsapps_evtstudy_int).

databases.name: TAQ (Trade and Quote)
databases.notes: Intraday trades and quotes for US equities (millisecond TAQ; schema: taqmsec).

databases.name: RiskMetrics
databases.notes: Risk management / governance datasets (now delivered under ISS; schemas: risk, risk_governance, risk_directors).

databases.name: EBSCO Business eBook Collection
databases.notes: Trial access until November 2026.

databases.name: Harvard Business eBook Collection
databases.notes: Harvard Business Review Press collection. Trial until November 2026.

databases.name: Knowledgestore (Markets and Markets)
databases.notes: Market research on high-growth niche markets.

databases.name: Portfolio Management Research
databases.notes: Finance and investment publications.

databases.name: South African Newspaper Archive
databases.notes: Historical South African newspapers (Rand Daily Mail, Sunday Times, Sowetan).

not_available.name: NielsenIQ (Nielsen Retail Scanner / Consumer Panel)
not_available.notes: Not available at EUR - no Nielsen / Kilts-NielsenIQ subscription on WRDS (verified 2026-06). Closest alternative at EUR: Circana (IRI) retail scanner data via WRDS.

not_available.name: GfK
not_available.notes: Not available at EUR - not on WRDS (verified 2026-06). For consumer/retail scanner data use Circana (IRI) via WRDS.

not_available.name: Sustainalytics
not_available.notes: Standalone Sustainalytics not confirmed at EUR. Some ESG coverage is available via WRDS (Sustainalytics samples, MSCI ESG samples, S&P Trucost, LSEG/Refinitiv ESG, RepRisk) - verify the specific module/coverage you need.

not_available.name: Survivor-Bias-Free Mutual Fund Database
not_available.notes: Standalone product access removed July 1, 2025. CRSP Survivor-Bias-Free US Mutual Fund data remains accessible via WRDS (schema: crsp_q_mutualfunds).
